native_mirror_semantics:
Native evidence, existing Ghidra project opened read-only and CLOSED without save.
These outputs were obtained directly with pyghidra, not a new REA tool invocation.

UIBasicSprite.SimpleFillMirror VA180EC5AC0 (RVA EC5AC0)
metadata il2cpp/dump/cs/il2cpp.cs:578745
If neither mirror flag is set, calls original SimpleFill.
One flag => 2 quads; both => 4 quads. Geometry and UV are separate operations.
Coord.AddSectionPoints VA180EE8390 divides geometry at the midpoint.
UVCoord.AddSectionPoints VA180EE9410 repeats the FULL supplied UV rectangle.
For horizontal-only, rotate=false:
  xMid=(xMin+xMax)/2
  quad0 geometry=(xMin,yMin),(xMin,yMax),(xMid,yMax),(xMid,yMin)
  quad0 UV=(uMin,vMin),(uMin,vMax),(uMax,vMax),(uMax,vMin)
  quad1 geometry=(xMid,yMin),(xMid,yMax),(xMax,yMax),(xMax,yMin)
  quad1 UV=(uMax,vMin),(uMax,vMax),(uMin,vMax),(uMin,vMin)
So PNG reconstruction for unrotated horizontal mirror is [original | flipX(original)].
36x72 becomes 72x72; 22x100 becomes 44x100. It is NOT a full-image flip and does
not cut the source UV in half. Widget geometry width itself is already final width;
do not double widget width again when replacing the original mirrored geometry.

UVCoord.GetPoint VA180EE9360 had no defined Ghidra Function; exact pseudo-disassembly
in mirror_uv_point_listing.txt was used (not a fabricated decompilation).
Pseudocode: index=mirrorH ? 3-index : index; index=positiveModulo(index,4);
base points=[(uMin,vMin),(uMin,vMax),(uMax,vMax),(uMax,vMin)];
mirrorV swaps vMin/vMax. UVCoord.AddSectionPoints sets mirrorH for section1 when
horizontal-only and rotate=false. rotate=true takes a different index-offset path;
do not apply the simple pixel-copy rule to rotating sprites without accounting for it.

UIBasicSprite.SlicedFillMirror VA180EC6CB0 (RVA EC6CB0)
metadata il2cpp/dump/cs/il2cpp.cs:578746
Neither flag => ordinary SlicedFill. Get border and pixelSize through virtual getters.
b=border*pixelSize. If b is all zero, calls SimpleFillMirror.
If H: b.left*=2; b.right*=2. If V: b.bottom*=2; b.top*=2.
Draw bands use xMin+b.left / xMax-b.right and yMin+b.bottom / yMax-b.top.
H-only has explicitly emitted outer corners and mirrored/split middle-band sections,
using the original sprite outer/inner UV rectangles, not just duplicating a standard
9-slice constructed from the raw half texture. Retain these geometry border widths.
Do not assume a naive unchanged-border Sprite.Create + Image.Sliced is equivalent.
This task proves the mirror orientation and doubled geometry border handling; full
mapping of reconstructed-texture border metadata should be validated against the
actual sprite's inner/outer UVs rather than guessed from its filename.

Evidence files: simple_fill_mirror.c, sliced_fill_mirror.c,
mirror_coord_sections.c, mirror_uv_sections.c, mirror_uv_point_listing.txt.
Session close logs: decompile_mirror_run.txt, decompile_mirror_helpers_run.txt.
